name: comics-catalogue-intelligence-smoke
comment: arc-21 Slice 4 (2026-08-23) runtime proof for the comics-catalogue-intelligence adoption (Slice 3, commit 9040b2b). Today's live Colosseum/data/comics_catalog.db carries the five new arc-21 tables schema-live but data-thin: curated_source/curated_source_claim/curated_source_issue/canonical_issue are 0 rows; curated_series_coverage has 1134 rows, ALL state 'bibliography_only' (the GetComics-provenance enrichment stage and the raw GCD mirror dump have not been run against the live data yet - Slice 2's own documented, accepted finding). This scenario proves GRACEFUL EMPTINESS and NON-REGRESSION on today's real, thin data - the app boots, reaches Tankoban, and both the Discover wall and the Comics tab render without error, surviving a world round-trip - NOT populated coverage shelves; that proof is deferred to a future enrichment task. Ground-truthed from source before driving (no invented behavior, NOT asserted live - see the bridge gaps below): ComicsCatalog::discoverFilters('availability') (native/engine/ComicsCatalog.cpp:596-618) degrades gracefully on this data - it never crashes or throws, it omits the 'available' facet entry (official_source_count is 0 everywhere) and returns exactly one entry, 'Bibliography only' (count 1134), because that value legitimately exists in curated_series_coverage; the 'format' facet is UNAFFECTED (it reads the pre-existing curated_edition table, 9655 rows, populated long before arc-21). ComicDbLedger.qml's coverageLabel() (qml/ComicDbLedger.qml:57-66) renders 'Bibliography only' inline in the series hero's meta line for any curated series whose coverage.availabilityState is 'bibliography_only'. THREE bridge gaps found and disclosed this slice (none introduced by arc-21, none fixed by this proof-only slice): (1) TankobanComicsTab.qml, ComicDbLedger.qml, ComicSeriesPage.qml, and TankobanDiscoverPage.qml carry ZERO objectNames (grep-confirmed empty on all four files) - shelf/ledger content can only be read off a grab, never asserted by property; (2) ComicsCatalog's own Q_INVOKABLEs (discoverFilters/curatedCoverage/curatedSeries) are NOT in the Lanista invoke-read allowlist (the ledger's 8-method list is TankobanVolumes + BiblioImageDiag only) - facet/coverage values cannot be read live through the bridge at all; (3) NEWLY FOUND this slice: DiscoverBrowser.qml's 'type lens' Manga/Comics toggle (the Row at DiscoverBrowser.qml:401-437, delegate id typeTab) carries NO objectName on any of its Tankoban/Theatre/Biblio call sites - the Discover tab boots defaulted to the Manga lens with no named way to switch to Comics, so a comics card (discoverCard_<locgId>) and the per-series ledger it opens are UNREACHABLE by name this slice; live-diagnosed via an interactive session (tag arc21s4diag, 2026-08-23) before this scenario's steps were finalized, confirmed by grab (the Comics lens is visibly present, just unnamed). This third gap means the bibliography_only ledger render was NOT runtime-witnessed this slice, by bridge or by human eyes - it is source-ground-truthed only (above); closing it needs either a future objectName addition to DiscoverBrowser.qml's typeTab delegate (out of this proof-only slice's fence) or a human-witnessed manual pass (boot -> Tankoban -> Discover tab -> click 'Comics' next to 'Manga' at the bottom-left type lens -> click any comics card -> confirm the hero meta line reads '... - Bibliography only' for a coverage-only series). What IS named and driven live, every run: modePill_Tankoban entry, a settle wait on tankobanTab_comics.enabled (fixes a real NO_SUCH_ITEM race a first live attempt hit - WorldTabBar's Repeater materializes its 4 delegates asynchronously right after world entry), tankobanWorld.activeTab tab-switch state (discover<->comics), the Comics tab surviving a modePill_Biblio/modePill_Tankoban world round-trip, and a trailing 'ping' proving the process is still alive after the whole flow.
